entries.critical_note: Signing block is Avuz-only — upstream 34.1.1 ships app/build.gradle.kts with NO signing config at all. The keystoreProps loader (reads keystore.properties), the signingConfigs { create("release") { ... } } block, and signingConfig = signingConfigs.getByName("release") on the release buildType must all be re-applied by hand on every upgrade. Miss any of them and release builds are unsigned/uninstallable. keystore.properties and keystore/avuz-conecta.jks are git-ignored and persist in the working tree across branch switches, so the secrets survive — only the build-file wiring needs re-applying. Verify post-merge with apksigner --print-certs (expect CN=Avuz Conecta).

entries.actual_outcome_34_1_1: Two conflict hunks on the Task 2 cherry-pick: (1) version block — resolved by keeping upstream's versionMajor/Minor/Patch/Build (34/1/1/90), discarding the old branding's 3/35/0/95; (2) defaultConfig hunk — kept upstream's testInstrumentationRunnerArguments map (TEST_SERVER_* + disableAnalytics) and grafted applicationId = "com.avuz.conecta" onto it. The signing block, keystore loader, and all per-flavor applicationIds auto-merged clean (not in conflict).

entries.description: Style tweaks for Avuz palette consistency. Theme.ownCloud.Launcher: parent → Theme.Material3.Light.NoActionBar (kills inflated AppCompat ActionBar that painted colorPrimary blue band at top). windowActionBar=false, windowNoTitle=true. windowBackground/statusBarColor/navigationBarColor → bg_drawer_header (#f2f6fb white). windowLightStatusBar/Navigation=true. Theme.App.Starting (system splash): mirrored white system bars + windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor=white + colorPrimary/Dark overrides for cold-start frame. Result: all-white launch + splash, no blue strips.
entries.notes: styles.xml is large and upstream-active. Audit each merge for missed updates.
entries.actual_outcome_34_1_1: The design spec flagged styles.xml as hand-merge risk (7 upstream commits between the 3.35.0 and 34.1.1 bases). It auto-merged cleanly on this cherry-pick, but keep treating it as high upstream-churn risk on future base bumps.

entries.description: Release build minification DISABLED (isMinifyEnabled=false) to match upstream Nextcloud config. Upstream ships release unminified — code is not tested with R8 and minification breaks reflection-based features (Apache HttpClient via OwnCloudClientFactory, Guava TypeToken in FileUploadWorker, etc). proguard-rules.pro retained for future re-enable if needed but currently unused.
entries.notes: Trade-off: ~3x larger AAB (~140MB vs ~45MB) but zero R8-related crashes. Play AAB delivery + per-ABI/density splits keep on-device install size reasonable. Revisit only if shipping minify becomes essential.
entries.actual_outcome_34_1_1: proguard-rules.pro auto-merged cleanly on the Task 2 cherry-pick (isMinifyEnabled=false lives inside the build.gradle.kts hand-merge, see branding-build-config).
